fusions.name: Gnawed-Bone Toss
fusions.desc: Throws a gnawed bone for 7 damage. It holds 5 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Elbows at the Table
fusions.desc: Shoves every enemy within 3 tiles for 12 damage, knocking them back 3 tiles, and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Shared Haunch
fusions.desc: Restores 15 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Second Helping
fusions.desc: Each time you kill an enemy, 3 stamina a second comes back to you for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
